name: Severe combined immunodeficiency due to CORO1A deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Immunological and genetic diagnostic criteria for SCID due to CORO1A deficiency

criteria.description: Profound T-cell lymphopenia with normal or elevated B-cell counts
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the CORO1A gene
Severely impaired T-cell proliferation in response to mitogens and antigens
Low or absent T-cell receptor excision circles (TRECs) indicating impaired thymic output
Early onset of severe, recurrent infections including opportunistic pathogens

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of profound T-cell lymphopenia, severely impaired T-cell function, and biallelic pathogenic CORO1A variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for definitive diagnosis; newborn screening for TRECs may aid early detection.

pathognomonic.notes: Marked reduction in circulating CD3+ T cells
Including Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia and disseminated viral infections
searchTerms: frequent serious infections from weak immunity
severe recurring infections due to immune deficiency

pathognomonic.notes: Poor lymphocyte response to mitogens and antigens

common.notes: Poor weight gain and growth delay
Often due to infections or malabsorption
Persistent fungal infection of the oral mucosa
Enlarged lymph nodes due to infections or immune dysregulation
Enlargement of liver and spleen secondary to immune activation

occasional.notes: Frequent lung infections caused by encapsulated bacteria
Persistent viral replication due to immune deficiency
searchTerms: long-term infections with CMV or EBV

rare.notes: Secondary to chronic infections or metabolic disturbances
Liver inflammation due to viral infections or immune dysregulation

laboratory: Profound T-cell lymphopenia with normal or elevated B-cell counts
Absent or severely reduced T-cell receptor excision circles (TRECs)
Elevated serum IgM with low or absent IgG and IgA
imaging: Chest X-ray showing absent or hypoplastic thymus
Radiographic evidence of pneumonia or other infections
other: Newborn screening positive for low TRECs
Flow cytometry showing absent naive T-cell populations

distinguishingFeatures: Absent T and NK cells with normal or elevated B cells

redFlags: Severe, recurrent, and opportunistic infections in early infancy
Failure to thrive with chronic diarrhea and oral candidiasis
references: Notarangelo LD, et al. Primary immunodeficiencies: 2020 update. J Allergy Clin Immunol. 2020.
Moshous D, et al. CORO1A deficiency causes immunodeficiency with lymphopenia. J Clin Invest. 2013.
Orphanet Report: Severe combined immunodeficiency due to CORO1A deficiency, ORPHA:228003.
